text:
sara: Heads-up: PR #4821 updates streaming examples for pagination+retries across py/ts/go. Need quick sync on snippet changes and doc link updates.

mike: Saw the PR. Main concern: Python's async iterator example breaks when reconnecting after a retry; we should show KV cache preserve and cursor resume, otherwise users hit duplicate tokens.

anya: I can add a short note + code example for resume token. Proposed snippet (python):
```py
async for chunk in client.responses.stream(request) :
    process(chunk.data)
    last_token = chunk.resume_token
# on retry, pass resume_token=last_token to resume from same KV cache point
```

tom: Can we avoid bloating doc? Maybe add a tiny migration note under 'Streaming' and link to 'Retries' section — short, actionable.

sara: Agree. Also TS + Go need parity. Anya, can you do TS? Mike, can you do Go?

anya: On it. TS draft (keeps it compact):
```ts
for await (const part of client.responses.stream(req)) {
  handle(part.data)
  resumeToken = part.resumeToken
}
// retry: client.responses.stream({ ...req, resumeToken })
```

mike: Go doesn't have async iterators; use a channel pattern. I'll push a minimal example to PR. Also fixed a broken anchor link in retries.md (was `#retry-strategy` -> `#retries`).

sara: Nice. Tom can you approve doc structure? We need to publish before EOD to match SDK release.

tom: I can review after lunch. Quick check: are we adding an extra section or one-liner? Keep it <=7 lines per language.

anya: :thumbsup: will keep compact. Also adding a small note about backpressure and batch size so users don't end up in infinite loops when retrying streaming pagination.

deploy-bot: docs-bot: New commit pushed to branch docs/sdk-stream-retries at 2212345700

sara: Thanks — final ask: can someone verify the code fence formatting in the HTML build? Last time triple backticks inside table cells got escaped.

mike: I will run local `mkdocs serve` and confirm before merge.

anya: I'll update PR description with checklist: [x] python example [x] ts example [x] go example [ ] build verified

sara: Perfect. I'll merge early if build green. :pray:
